name: Baracuta
why: Manchester, 1937 — the G9 Harrington is the archetype: Fraser tartan lining, umbrella-vent back, worn by Elvis, McQueen, and every mod since.
origin: The Miller brothers, Manchester, 1937 — rainwear makers whose ninth golf jacket (G9) became the Harrington; the Fraser tartan lining is licensed from the clan.
opview: Positions the G9 as the original — every other Harrington is a copy.

onething.n: verified — the house's own G9 Harrington collection. €399, made in the UK, in eight colours; the Fraser tartan lining is woven in Coolmax. The wider G9 page carries the suede, leather, denim and ripstop cuts of the same jacket

notes.ivy: the Harrington entered the Ivy wardrobe through golf and never left
notes.cotton: the G9 cloth — poplin outside, tartan inside

cities: Own London store · dept & specialty in US
